purpose: Evaluate incremental or underused primary evidence for deliverable Intel server CPU growth. No valuation, PDF, builder or frozen model edits.
evidence_admission: Direct company filings/releases or named management statements transcribed from dated events; separate provider transcript verification from official audio verification. Search snippets alone do not establish precise operational quantities.
prior_findings_to_not_relabel_new: 40% substrate capacity with much in H2 2027
AT&S Nov5 FY26/27 line timetable and unnamed customer
new_candidate: Aug26 CFO statement: aim to more than double Ireland output in 2027. Matched published transcripts; output unit and baseline undefined.

operating_assumptions_before_calculation.conditional_family_bridge: Total unit ratio = f*r*c + (1-f)*(1+l), where f is 2026 qualified-unit share tied to Ireland, r is output ratio in a consistently defined good-silicon measure, c converts that output to shipped same-scope packages after yields, die count, product allocation, substrates/test and acceptance, and l is other-family unit growth. None of f/r/c/l are publicly identified by a doubling statement alone.
operating_assumptions_before_calculation.illustrative_threshold_cases: Only if r=2 and c=1, solve minimum f for +20% total units at legacy growth 0/-10/-20/-30%. These are requirements, not estimates or forecasts.
operating_assumptions_before_calculation.ASP_policy: ASP per CPU may be decomposed into weighted cores per CPU and realized price per core only within comparable product scopes; do not treat either as observed for Intel total fleet without data. No extra scarcity-price or mix uplift inferred from higher substrate consumption.
operating_assumptions_before_calculation.model_action_threshold: Increase forecast only with Intel-specific output and period plus conversion/qualification evidence; lower or reclassify baseline if calendar or competitive demand falsifies the current quantities. Stronger factory evidence alone can improve the narrative without changing numbers.

valuation: No valuation or target recalculation in this workstream.
